description: IdroGEO (Italian platform on landslide and flood hazard) is a hazard data portal run by ISPRA (Italian Institute for Environmental Protection and Research). The platform lets users consult, share and download the Inventory of Landslide Phenomena in Italy (IFFI), the national mosaic hazard maps for landslides and floods, and risk indicators for population, families, buildings, businesses and cultural heritage; the page title reads "La piattaforma italiana sul dissesto idrogeologico". Coverage: Italy, national coverage with regional detail. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is: open data according to the search summaries; terms not read. Caveats: the page is drawn by script, so only its title and the search summaries were read; file formats, licence terms and the update date are unverified. It can support landslide and flood exposure screening of infrastructure assets and regional planning studies. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet; the data are reached through the portal page linked here. This record was written from the primary page fetched on 2026-09-30: only the page title and meta description came back (the page is drawn by script); statements come from those and from search result summaries; the data themselves were not downloaded.
